app_info.name: SwarmSpace
app_info.subtitle: Multi-source research intelligence
app_info.description: SwarmSpace gives ChatGPT 13 research intelligence tools powered by live multi-source data. Each tool chains web search, academic databases (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar), news feeds, Wikipedia, GitHub, and more into a single structured output. Tools cover deep research, competitor analysis, academic literature, news briefings, market scans, health research, technology evaluation, fact-checking, location intelligence, marketing briefs, content briefs, meeting prep, and plugin ecosystem analysis. All tools are read-only and return cited, structured results.

deep_research.title: Deep Research
deep_research.description: Comprehensive research combining web search, Wikipedia, and academic papers. Use for in-depth topic research, background research, or when multiple source types are needed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and returns research results only. No writes, deletions, or state changes of any kind.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries live web search, Wikipedia, and academic databases — results come from the open internet and vary by query.

competitor_analysis.title: Competitor Analysis
competitor_analysis.description: Competitive intelligence from web search, news, and Hacker News community. Use to analyze a company, product, or technology's competitive position and community sentiment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a competitive analysis report only. No data is written or modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries live web search, news feeds, and Hacker News — open internet sources.

marketing_brief.title: Marketing Brief
marketing_brief.description: Content marketing brief with trending themes, SEO keywords, and audience pain points. Use to plan content strategy for a topic or product.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a structured marketing brief only. No data is written or modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches trending content themes and SEO signals from live web sources.

plugin_ecosystem_analysis.title: Plugin Ecosystem Analysis
plugin_ecosystem_analysis.description: API and plugin ecosystem analysis showing existing integrations, patterns, and gaps. Use to understand what tools and APIs exist in a technology space.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns an ecosystem analysis report only. No data is written or modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches the open web for existing APIs, plugins, and integrations in a technology space.

academic_research.title: Academic Research
academic_research.description: Deep academic literature review across Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed. Use for scientific research, medical topics, or finding peer-reviewed evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries public academic databases and returns paper summaries and citations. No writes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed — publicly accessible academic databases on the open internet.

news_brief.title: News Brief
news_brief.description: Multi-source news intelligence briefing from mainstream news, Hacker News, and web search. Use to get a current, synthesized overview of news on any topic.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and returns a news summary only. No data is written or modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches live news from mainstream sources, Hacker News, and web search — results vary with current events.

market_scan.title: Market Scan
market_scan.description: Financial and market overview including analysis, key metrics, and exchange rate context. Use for market research, financial overviews, or economic analysis.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns market analysis only. No access to brokerage accounts, no transactions, no writes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches live financial news and exchange rate data from public internet sources.

location_brief.title: Location Brief
location_brief.description: Geographic intelligence with geocoding, current weather, country data, and Wikipedia context. Use to get a complete picture of a location.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and returns a location report only. No data is written or modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries live geocoding, weather, and Wikipedia APIs — open internet data sources.

health_research.title: Health Research
health_research.description: Biomedical research summary from PubMed, academic papers, and Wikipedia with clinical evidence assessment. Includes disclaimer that this is not medical advice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries public health databases and returns summaries with citations. No writes. Always includes a not-medical-advice disclaimer.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and Wikipedia — publicly accessible databases on the open internet.

tech_scout.title: Tech Scout
tech_scout.description: Technology evaluation covering GitHub ecosystem, Hacker News adoption signals, web research, and academic papers. Use to assess a technology's maturity, community, and alternatives.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches public data and returns a technology evaluation report. No writes or modifications.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries GitHub, Hacker News, web search, and academic databases — all open internet sources.

fact_check.title: Fact Check
fact_check.description: Multi-source fact verification using web search, Wikipedia, academic sources, and dictionary. Returns verdict (Supported/Partially Supported/Unsupported/Unverifiable) with evidence and confidence level.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cross-references a claim against public sources and returns a verdict with evidence. No writes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries web search, Wikipedia, and academic sources — open internet verification.

content_brief.title: Content Brief
content_brief.description: Content creation brief with research, outline, key data points, and SEO suggestions. Use to plan a blog post, article, or other content piece.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a structured content brief only. No content is published or written to any system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches live web research and SEO data to inform the brief — open internet sources.

meeting_prep.title: Meeting Prep
meeting_prep.description: Pre-meeting intelligence brief with attendee background and talking points from web research. Use before a meeting to prepare informed talking points.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches public sources and returns a briefing document. No calendar writes, no contact modifications.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool never modifies, deletes, or overwrites any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches the open web for publicly available information about the attendee and meeting context.

test_cases.description: Deep research on a broad technology topic
test_cases.user_prompt: Do deep research on the current state of AI agent frameworks
test_cases.expected_output: Structured research report covering overview, key frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.), recent developments, academic references, and a summary of the state of the field.

test_cases.description: Competitive analysis of a well-known product
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a competitor analysis on Notion
test_cases.expected_output: Competitive intelligence brief with sections: Overview, Key Players (Obsidian, Coda, Confluence, etc.), Recent Moves, Hacker News community sentiment, and Strategic Implications.

test_cases.user_prompt: Fact check: The Eiffel Tower is taller than the Empire State Building
test_cases.expected_output: Verdict: Unsupported. Evidence from Wikipedia and web sources confirming the Empire State Building (443m) is taller than the Eiffel Tower (330m). Confidence: High.

test_cases.description: News briefing on a current topic
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a news brief on quantum computing
test_cases.expected_output: Synthesized news briefing with recent headlines from mainstream news, Hacker News discussion threads, and web sources. Structured overview of key developments.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prep me for a meeting with Sam Altman at OpenAI, we're discussing AI safety
test_cases.expected_output: Intelligence brief with attendee background (Sam Altman's role, public statements, recent news), company context (OpenAI's safety initiatives), and suggested talking points for an AI safety discussion.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find academic research on transformer attention mechanisms
test_cases.expected_output: Literature review citing peer-reviewed papers from arXiv and Semantic Scholar, with paper titles, authors, abstracts, and relevance to the query.

test_cases.user_prompt: Scout the Bun JavaScript runtime for me
test_cases.expected_output: Technology evaluation covering GitHub activity, community adoption signals from Hacker News, performance benchmarks from web research, alternatives comparison, and maturity assessment.

negative_test_cases.description: Request to write or create files
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a research report and save it to my Google Drive
negative_test_cases.reason: SwarmSpace tools are read-only research tools. They return structured text — they do not write to external services, file systems, or user accounts.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the home address and phone number of John Smith in Austin Texas
negative_test_cases.reason: SwarmSpace does not perform personal data lookups. Tools search public sources for topical research, not individual private information.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy me 10 shares of Apple stock
negative_test_cases.reason: SwarmSpace has no transactional tools. market_scan returns financial analysis only — it has no access to brokerage accounts or trading platforms.
